I shaped iteration 0198 as one task: `step4-patch-plan-0198` (researcher, default model, medium effort, 45 min / 30 turns).

Why: step 4 of the positive-control thread (#763 f4) has now failed three times, in #834, #838 and #848 (record `.session/history/records/0197.json`). Each time the cause was tools, not the task. In #848, Read worked twice and then Read and Grep came back "disabled for this session". Grep had also returned empty matches on `benchmark/scripts/score.py`, which exists (`.session/reports/848.json`). My working memory says not to order a fourth full author attempt, so I split the work. This session changes no repository file. It saves an exact patch plan to `.session/artifacts/step4-patch.md`: the old and new score.py text for the A0001 wrong-literal and A0002 wrong-locator mutations, the F4 answer with the inventory lines, every pinned file and pin location, and the regeneration commands. A later apply session should then need only a few turns. The task falls back to reading files in ranges when Grep comes back empty.

Expected gain: the artifact appears in record 0198. The next shaper orders a short apply task (benchmark role, at most 15 turns) with this artifact as input, plus a changed-scope review in the same graph.

Other outputs:
- `.session/suggestions.json`: the tool-disable suggestion for the Policymaker, raised again with the #848 evidence (turn-dependent disable, Grep returning empty matches).
- `journal/working-memory.md`: rewritten with the four sections.
- `.session/tasks.json`: passed the direct Python JSON/heading check (exit 0).

## What next
- If the researcher is also blocked by tools, stop ordering step 4 and wait for the Policymaker to act on the suggestion. Meanwhile, plan independent work that needs few turns.
- Do not repeat what earlier sessions settled: F1 (#828), F2 (#831), F3, the cold key (0191).

- Shaper #847 crashed after 21 turns in iteration 0197; the engine used #846's graph instead (record 0197).
- `policy_rev` changed from 5e598014 to eab63e96 between 0197 and 0198 (`.session/loop-state.json`).
